Cloudpepper | Senior Platform / DevOps Engineer | Remote (CET overlap) or Brussels | Full-time | $150k–$180k | https://cloudpepper.io/careers/platform-engineer/

We run the platform behind 10,000+ Odoo instances and we're looking for a Senior Platform / DevOps Engineer to join us.

Stack: Symfony/PHP, Ansible, Linux, PostgreSQL, Nginx, Python.

This is a senior role that spans both sides of the platform: backend work in Symfony/PHP, and ownership of the Linux + Ansible automation underneath. You'll be the person making sure the whole thing keeps humming as we scale.

We're a small team with high ownership and very little bureaucracy — if you like shipping over slide decks, you'll fit in.

Remote is fine as long as you can overlap with CET, or you're welcome to join us in Brussels.

Full role and application: https://cloudpepper.io/careers/platform-engineer/
